DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通り道についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a path, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の前の道が雨のあと歩きにくくなります。市に直してもらいたいのですが、その道が市道か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨後の通路改善希望と市道か不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The path in front of my home becomes difficult to walk on after rain. I would like the city to repair it, but I do not know whether it is a city road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want the path improved after rain and do not know whether it is a city road. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所を案内図で示していただけますか。管理する所も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show the location on the map? We will also check who manages it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この細い通路です。大きい道から建物まで続いていて、大家さんは敷地内と言っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 細い道の場所と大家の敷地内発言を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this narrow passage. It runs from the main road to the building, and my landlord said it was within the property.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show where the narrow path is and mention the landlord's statement that it is within the property. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのお話も担当へ伝えましょう。市の道と確認できないまま修理の申込みにはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us pass that information to the person in charge as well. We cannot treat this as a repair application before confirming that it is a city road.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。工事の日を約束してほしいという相談ではなく、まず誰へ相談する場所か知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 工事確約より管理先確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I am not asking for a promised construction date; first, I want to know whom to consult about this location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to identify the manager rather than secure a construction commitment. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 雨がやんだ今の状態は、写真などで説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you explain its present condition now that the rain has stopped, using photographs or something similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真は二枚あります。撮るために隣の敷地へ入らず、自分の玄関から見える範囲を撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 侵入せず撮った写真を説明資料として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have two photographs. I did not enter the neighboring property to take them; I photographed the area visible from my own entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the photographs taken without trespassing as material to explain the situation. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 雨の時と今の違いも伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Could you also tell us how it differs between when it rains and now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 雨の時は水がたまり、今は泥が残っています。担当には場所、大家さんの話、二つの状態を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 降雨時と現在の状態を分け担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Water collects when it rains, and mud remains now. I will explain the location, what the landlord said, and the two conditions separately to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the conditions during rain and at present separately to the person in charge. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を添えて管理先の確認へつなぎます。それでは、担当窓口へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will include the circumstances and arrange to check who manages it. Please proceed to the relevant counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 採血のあと、腕の具合はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: How is your arm feeling after the blood draw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 血を取った所のテープがかゆくなってきました。爪でかいてしまいそうなので、見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採血テープ周辺のかゆみを報告し確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The tape over the place where blood was taken has started itching. I feel I might scratch it with my nails, so I would like you to look at it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report itching around the blood-draw tape and ask for it to be checked. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: かゆい所を教えてください。今、出血はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me where it itches. Is there any bleeding now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: テープの周りです。血が出ているようには見えませんが、服で隠れている所もあるので、こちらで確かめてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 範囲と見える範囲の出血なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around the tape. It does not look as though it is bleeding, but some areas are hidden by my clothes, so I would like you to check here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the area affected and that there is no bleeding in the visible area. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態を確認します。何かご自身で塗ったり、貼り足したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check its condition. Have you applied anything or added any tape yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 何もしていません。家から持ってきたクリームがありますが、ここへ塗る前に声を掛けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未処置と持参クリームを塗る前に相談したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have done nothing. I have some cream I brought from home, but I called you before putting it on this area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not treated it and consulted before applying the cream you brought. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 塗るかどうかもこちらで確認しましょう。以前、同じようなことはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us also check whether the cream should be applied. Has anything similar happened before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 以前の採血ではかゆくありませんでした。別のテープでかぶれたことはありますが、今日のテープと同じかは知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 以前の別テープ反応と同一性不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It did not itch after previous blood draws. I have had a skin reaction to a different tape, but I do not know whether it was the same as today's tape.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention the previous reaction to another tape and that you do not know whether it was the same kind. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのことも担当へ伝えます。確認する間、気になる変化があれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge about that too. While we check, please tell us if you notice any changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変わったらすぐ伝えます。かくのも、上から自分の絆創膏を足すのもやめて、見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己掻破貼足しをせず変化を報告して確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell you immediately if it changes. I will avoid scratching or adding my own adhesive bandage over it, and have you look at it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for the check without scratching or adding tape yourself, and report any changes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、腕の状態を確認します。声を掛けてくださりありがとうございます。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check your arm. Thank you for letting us know. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 近所での出来事について、お話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will hear about what happened in your neighborhood.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、通路で相手に強い言葉を言われました。腹が立っていて、まず謝ってもらいたいという気持ちがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手の強い言葉と謝罪を求める感情を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday, someone spoke harshly to me in the passage. I am angry, and my first feeling is that I want them to apologize.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the other person's harsh words and your feelings about wanting an apology. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 起きたことを、覚えている順に教えてください。こちらで相手の謝罪を約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me what happened in the order you remember. We cannot promise that the other person will apologize.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先に私が荷物を通路へ置き、相手が通れなくなりました。それを怒られたので、私も大声で言い返しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の通路阻害と大声応答も話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: First, I put my belongings in the passage, and the other person could not get through. They got angry about that, so I shouted back too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Also describe your own obstruction of the passage and your shouted response. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相手から受けた言葉と、ご自身が言ったことも分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask separately about what the other person said to you and what you said yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手は通路を空けてと言い、私は今やっていると言いました。脅すような言葉があったとは、今の記憶では言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 双方の発言を示し脅迫は未認識と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They said to clear the passage, and I said I was doing it now. Based on what I remember now, I cannot say that there were any threatening words.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State what each person said, distinguishing this from any threat, which you do not currently recognize. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: けがや物の破損はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Were there any injuries or damage to property?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありません。怖かったというより、恥ずかしくて怒っていました。それを危険な目に遭ったという言い方に変えたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 被害感情を危険の断定へ置換せず無傷無破損を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I was embarrassed and angry rather than scared. I do not want to change that into saying that I was put in danger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that there were no injuries or damage without replacing your feelings of being wronged with a definite claim of danger. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今後どうしたいかも伺い、適切な相談先を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also ask what you would like to do next and check the appropriate place to consult.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物を置いたことは私から謝りたいです。相手へ一方的に謝罪させる手続きではなく、今後の相談先を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己謝罪希望と今後の相談先を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want to apologize for putting my belongings there. I want to ask where to seek advice in the future, rather than use a process to make only the other person apologize.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Express your wish to apologize yourself and ask where to seek advice in the future. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況とご希望を伺いました。相談先を確認しますので、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have heard the circumstances and your wishes. I will check where you can consult. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いつお届けしたいお荷物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: When would you like your parcel delivered?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行中に買った物を家へ送りたいです。私が帰るのは来週なので、今日送ると家で受け取る人がいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅前に荷物が届くと受取人不在になると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to send home things I bought during my trip. I return next week, so if I send them today, nobody will be home to receive them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that there will be nobody to receive the parcel if it arrives before you return home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 到着日の指定については、利用する送り方の条件を確認します。今日送る必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the conditions for specifying an arrival date for the shipping method you use. Do you need to send it today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 急ぎではありません。宿でしばらく荷物を置けるか、宿の人に聞いてから差し出す日を決めてもよいと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 急ぎでなく宿保管後の後日発送を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is not urgent. I think I could decide when to send it after asking the accommodation staff whether they can keep my things for a while.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is not urgent and you are considering sending it later after storage at your accommodation. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで保管を引き受ける約束はできません。発送前の保管場所はご自身で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot promise to store it here. Please check for yourself where you can keep it before shipping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 郵便局に預けておくつもりではありません。宿へ聞いて、できなければ自分で持ち帰ることも考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 局保管依頼でなく宿確認や自己持帰りを検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not intend to leave it at the post office. I will ask my accommodation, and if that is not possible, I will also consider taking it home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you are not requesting post-office storage and are considering asking your accommodation or taking it home yourself. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身と箱の大きさは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know the contents and the size of the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 衣類と本です。箱はこの大きさで、旅の最終日も自分で持ってこちらへ来られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内容と大きさ後日持参可能を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Clothes and books. The box is this size, and I can bring it here myself on the last day of my trip too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the contents and size, and say you can bring it on a later day. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送り方と指定の条件を確認してから、日程を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us decide the schedule after checking the shipping method and the conditions for specifying a date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は条件だけを聞き、まだ発送を頼みません。宿の保管可否と帰宅日を合わせて、いつ差し出すか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は条件確認のみで差出しを保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will only ask about the conditions and will not request shipment yet. I will decide when to send it by considering whether my accommodation can store it and when I return home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that today you are only checking the conditions and are postponing sending the parcel. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 条件の案内をお渡しします。それでは、ご旅行の続きをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will give you information about the conditions. Enjoy the rest of your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 積立の予定を変更したいというご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss changing your regular savings schedule, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給料日が変わったので、積立の日もずらしたいです。ただ、変更した月に二回引き落とされないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給料日変更で積立日をずらし二回引落しを心配する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My payday has changed, so I also want to move my savings payment date. However, I am worried about being debited twice in the month of the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to move the savings date because your payday changed, and are worried about two debits. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の契約と、希望する日を確認しましょう。お手元に契約の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check your current contract and preferred date. Do you have your copy of the contract?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。今は十日で、希望は二十五日です。毎月の金額は変えたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現契約と希望日を示し金額変更なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. It is currently the tenth, and I would like the twenty-fifth. I do not want to change the monthly amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your current contract and preferred date, and say that the amount will not change. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切替え月の扱いは契約担当が確認します。未確認の回数をこちらで断定せず、変更条件を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person responsible for the contract will check how the transition month is handled. I will not state an unconfirmed number of debits as fact here; I will check the change conditions with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日付を変更するだけで、積立自体をもう一件作る申込みはしません。今の契約の変更として相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新契約追加でなく既存契約変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am only changing the date, not applying to create another savings contract. I want to discuss changing the current contract.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to change the existing contract rather than add a new one. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ、日付だけの変更希望と申し送りします。変更が適用される月も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass on your wish to change only the date. Please also check the month when the change will take effect.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 適用月と、その月の引落し回数を聞きます。二十五日にしたつもりでも、回答が来るまでは今の予定を残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 適用月回数を確認し未確定の間は旧予定を保つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask about the effective month and the number of debits in that month. Even if I intend to make it the twenty-fifth, I will retain the current schedule until I get a reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the effective month and number of debits and retain the old schedule until confirmed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい案内を受けたら、ご自身の予定表も直しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you receive the new information, please correct your own calendar as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確定した日だけ予定表へ書き直します。今日は新しい積立を増やさず、今の契約の変更条件を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定案内後に予定表を直すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will change the calendar only to the confirmed date. Today, I will ask about the conditions for changing my existing contract without adding new savings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to update your calendar after receiving confirmed information. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 控えとご希望を担当へお渡しします。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will give your copy and request to the person in charge. Please wait here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのカートは大人の方が見ていてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please have an adult keep an eye on that cart.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが押していますが、試食を見つけて急に方向を変えました。人に当たる前に止めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子の急な方向転換を説明し衝突前にカートを止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child is pushing it, but spotted the food samples and suddenly changed direction. I will stop it before it hits anyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your child's sudden change of direction and stop the cart before a collision. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここで一度止まり、通路を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please stop here for a moment and clear the aisle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カートを脇へ寄せました。子どもだけ先に試食台へ走らせず、私と一緒に待つよう話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 脇に寄せ子を単独で走らせず一緒に待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have moved the cart to the side. I will tell my child to wait with me rather than let them run ahead alone to the sampling table.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move aside and have your child wait with you without running off alone. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: カートが軽くても、急に動かすと危険です。お買物の続きはどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even a light cart is dangerous if moved suddenly. How will you continue shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の売場までは私が押します。子どもには、前を見ずに試食へ向かったことを落ち着いて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 親が押し方向転換の危険を子へ説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will push it as far as the next section. I will calmly explain to my child about heading for the samples without looking ahead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the parent will push the cart and explain the danger of changing direction to the child. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 試食を希望される場合は、カートを通路に残さず並んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you want samples, please line up without leaving your cart in the aisle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子どもには試食の内容もまだ分かりません。急いで取る前に表示を一緒に見て、食べるか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 試食内容未確認なので表示から判断すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: My child does not yet know what the samples contain either. Before rushing to take one, we will look at the label together and decide whether to eat it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that since you have not checked the sample's contents, you will decide from the label. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 食べられない材料などがあれば、担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: If there are ingredients you cannot eat, please ask the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を見てから担当へ聞きます。いまは私が押して台の近くまでゆっくり移り、列と通路を空けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 親が徐行し試食列と通路を空ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will look at the label and then ask the staff member. For now, I will push slowly toward the table and keep the line and aisle clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the parent will push slowly and keep the sampling line and aisle clear. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、お買物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方の帽子に、小さな虫が付いていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: There is a small insect on your companion's hat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 気づきました。虫が苦手な友人なので、いきなり手で払うと驚かせそうです。先に本人へ静かに伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の虫への苦手さを踏まえ先に知らせると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I noticed. My friend dislikes insects, so suddenly brushing it off by hand might startle them. I will quietly tell them first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your friend first, considering their dislike of insects. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 周囲の人へも、大きく腕を振って当たらないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please also avoid swinging your arms widely and hitting people around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人へ伝えたら、帽子を外してほしいと言われました。私が虫をつぶしてしまうのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の帽子除去希望と虫を潰さない意向を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: When I told my friend, they asked to have the hat removed. I want to avoid crushing the insect myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend wants the hat removed and that you do not intend to crush the insect. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 虫の種類はこちらでは判断できません。無理に素手で触らず、帽子を外して置く場所を考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot identify the insect here. Rather than force yourself to touch it barehanded, let us think about where to put the hat after removing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 人が座っているベンチへ投げません。友人が自分で外して、近くの空いた地面へ静かに置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人が帽子を外し空いた地面へ静置する方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will not throw it onto a bench where people are sitting. My friend will remove it themselves and gently place it on an empty patch of ground nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose to have your friend remove their own hat and set it gently on empty ground. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 虫が離れるまでは、ほかの方が帽子を踏まないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Until the insect leaves, please make sure nobody steps on the hat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで見て待ちます。虫を撮るために友人の顔へ携帯を近づけることもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 踏付けを避け見守り無断顔撮影をしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will stay here watching and wait. I will not bring my phone up to my friend's face to photograph the insect either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will watch to prevent it being stepped on and will not photograph your friend's face without permission. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 虫が離れたら、帽子の状態を確認してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once the insect leaves, please check the hat's condition and take it with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 離れたのを見ました。友人に知らせて帽子を受け取り、無理に頭へかぶせず本人へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 虫離脱を知らせ帽子を本人へ返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I saw it leave. I will tell my friend, pick up the hat, and return it to them without forcing it onto their head.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your friend the insect has left and return their hat. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 落ち着いて対応できましたね。それでは、散策をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You handled that calmly. Enjoy your walk. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのベンチでお食事の予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to eat on this bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 弁当を開けたら、においが思ったより強かったです。隣の方が離れたので、ここで食べ続けるのを迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 弁当の強いにおいに気づき食事継続を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I opened my boxed lunch, the smell was stronger than I expected. The person beside me moved away, so I am unsure whether to keep eating here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you noticed the strong smell of your lunch and ask about continuing your meal. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ふたを閉じて、周囲をご覧ください。食事場所の案内は確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please close the lid and look around you. We can check the information about places to eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 閉じました。離れた方が私の弁当のせいだと確かめたわけではないので、追いかけて説明はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 蓋を閉じ他人退席の理由は断定しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have closed it. I have not confirmed that the person left because of my lunch, so I will not follow them to explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have closed the lid and will not assume why the other person left. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちの品が漏れないように包んでください。どこで食べたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wrap what you have so it will not leak. Where would you like to eat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 列車が来るまでに急いで食べるより、駅の外で食べられる場所を探したいです。券の扱いも聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅外食事場所と出場券扱いを確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to find somewhere outside the station where I can eat, rather than rush to eat before the train arrives. Could I also ask how my ticket will be handled?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check places to eat outside the station and how your ticket is handled when leaving. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 改札を出る前に、券を係員へお見せください。食事の場所は、ご自身でも利用案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before leaving through the gate, please show your ticket to a staff member. Please also check the user information about eating areas yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に券を見せます。においを消すためにこのベンチへスプレーをかけることはせず、弁当を持って移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 消臭スプレーを使わず品を持って移動すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show the ticket first. I will not spray this bench to remove the smell; I will take my lunch with me and move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to move with your food without using deodorizing spray. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ベンチに食べ物を残していないかもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check that you have not left any food on the bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こぼれていません。袋へ戻して持ちました。券の確認後、急いで食べずに別の場所へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食べ残しなしを確かめ券確認後に場所変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not spilled anything. I put it back in the bag and am holding it. After checking my ticket, I will go somewhere else without eating in a hurry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that no food remains and change locations after having your ticket checked. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お手元の券を確認します。それでは、こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check the ticket you have. Please come this way. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の相談では、ご家族が通訳されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will your family member interpret at today's consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 娘が一緒ですが、まだ小学生です。難しい通知を娘だけに説明させるのは負担だと思い、通訳の支援を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小学生の娘へ複雑な通知通訳を任せず支援を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My daughter is with me, but she is still in elementary school. I think making her alone explain a difficult notice is a burden, so I would like to ask about interpreting support.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Seek support rather than entrusting a complicated notice's interpretation to your elementary-school daughter. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 希望する言語を教えてください。利用できる方法を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your preferred language. I will check the available methods with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。娘は日常の日本語は分かりますが、お金や手続きの話まで理解できるとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望言語と娘の理解の範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vietnamese. My daughter understands everyday Japanese, but I cannot say that she understands matters involving money or procedures too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your preferred language and the limits of your daughter's understanding. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お子さんの理解を前提にせず、ご本人が説明を確認できる方法を探しましょう。今日は急ぎの期限がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us find a way for you to check the explanation yourself without assuming your child understands. Is there an urgent deadline today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 期限は来週です。今ここで全部決めず、支援の利用ができる日を聞いてから詳しい相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限まで余裕があり支援日決定後に詳しく相談したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The deadline is next week. Rather than decide everything here now, I would like to ask when support is available and then have a detailed consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say there is time before the deadline and you want a detailed consultation after arranging a support date. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約方法も担当へ確認します。質問したい点は整理してありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will also check how to make an appointment with the person in charge. Have you organized what you want to ask?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つあります。通知の意味と、準備する資料です。娘に訳を作らせず、自分の言葉で母語のメモにして持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二点の質問を自分で母語メモへ整理すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have two questions: what the notice means, and what documents to prepare. Rather than make my daughter translate, I will make notes in my native language in my own words and bring them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will organize the two questions yourself in notes in your native language. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通知の原本も、次の相談にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring the original notice to the next consultation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原本は手元にあります。支援の方法が分かったら、娘を通訳の役目から外して自分で説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原本持参と娘を通訳役から外す方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the original with me. Once I know what support is available, I will relieve my daughter of the interpreting role and listen to the explanation myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State that you will bring the original and remove your daughter from the interpreting role. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へ伝えます。それでは、支援窓口へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will convey your wishes to the person in charge. Let me guide you to the support counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 音のことで、何かご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss something about a noise?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯のアラームが鳴り、隣の方が起きてしまいました。朝の薬を忘れないためでしたが、止めるまで長く鳴りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の薬忘れ防止アラームが他患者を起こしたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My phone alarm rang and woke the person beside me. It was to help me remember my morning medicine, but it rang for a long time before I stopped it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your alarm for remembering your medicine woke another patient. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は止まっていますか。薬のことは担当と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has it stopped now? Let us check the medication with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は止めました。起きた隣の方へ、私の携帯だったと短く謝りました。病院の機器の音だと不安にさせたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 停止済み謝罪と音の発生元を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have stopped it now. I briefly apologized to the person beside me who woke up, saying it was my phone. I do not want to worry them into thinking it was hospital equipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it has stopped, that you apologized, and where the sound came from. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次のアラームの設定はどうなっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: How is the next alarm set?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毎日繰り返しなので、明日も同じ時刻に鳴ります。入院中の薬の時間はまだ担当に確かめていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 翌日繰返しと病棟服薬時刻未確認を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It repeats daily, so it will ring at the same time tomorrow. I have not yet checked my medication times during hospitalization with the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention tomorrow's repeating alarm and the unconfirmed ward medication time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 薬については、病棟の案内を確認してからにしてください。機器の音はご自身で止めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the ward's instructions about medication first. Do not turn off equipment sounds yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 止めるのは私の携帯だけです。薬を自己判断で飲むために、このアラームを使い続けるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己携帯のみ操作し自己服薬判断のアラーム使用をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will only turn off my own phone. I will stop continuing to use this alarm to take medicine based on my own judgment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will operate only your own phone and stop using the alarm for self-directed medication. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 携帯の通知音も、周囲への配慮をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also consider those around you when setting phone notification sounds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明日の繰返しを解除しました。薬の確認は担当へ相談し、携帯は音を出さない通知へ変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 繰返し解除と無音通知変更を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have canceled tomorrow's repetition. I will consult the person in charge about medication and change my phone to silent notifications.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report canceling the repetition and changing to silent notifications. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認を担当へつなぎます。それでは、ゆっくりお休みください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass the check on to the person in charge. Please rest well. Take care.
